name: Fuse Inventory
description:
An enterprise-grade MCP server built for multi-channel inventory planners and brand operators. Query sales, stock, purchasing, and vendor performance from Fuse Inventory without exporting a report.

Fuse consolidates and reconciles data from your sales channels (Shopify, Amazon, Faire, etc.), warehouse management systems (WMS), third-party logistics (3PL), and demand forecasting models. This connector reads directly from Fuse, so every answer is grounded in current, validated data.

Perfect for operations teams, financial analysts, and founders using Claude to inform inventory planning and supply chain decisions.

Key Capabilities & Tools:
- Multi-Channel Sales: View revenue and top sellers across all storefronts.
- Stock Levels: Track on-hand, available, inbound, and reserved quantities by SKU and warehouse. 
- PO Tracking: Monitor open purchase orders and ETAs by line item to accurately project upcoming procurement spend.
- Demand Planning: Identify high-risk SKUs before peak holiday seasons and review order recommendations.
- Supplier Accountability: Grade vendor lead times, track average and longest delays, and flag shipments that are late right now. 
- Product Mapping: Trace how SKUs relate to each other through bills of materials (BOM), variants, merges, and fulfillment SKUs.

Security & Requirements:
Requires an active Fuse Inventory account. Connect securely via OAuth using your existing Fuse credentials. Operates on a strict read-only basis.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fuse Inventory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fuse Inventory to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.fuseinventory.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fuse Inventory MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fuse Inventory provides these MCP tools: find_products, get_order_recommendations, get_sales_report, get_spend_and_cost_analysis, get_stock_levels, get_upcoming_stock, get_vendor_performance, and understand_product_relations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fuse Inventory?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fuse Inventory in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does Fuse Inventory MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fuse Inventory requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fuse Inventory is developed by Fuse Inventory. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
